column1: # ABR corpus record ledger — ANALYST-published derived artifact.
# Derived from the licensed .abr fixture corpus described in
# ANALYST-role session under the clean-room two-role protocol (plugin-
# image/CLAUDE.md §3.1). Contains only FACTS ABOUT BEHAVIOUR — counts, key
# names, OSTypes, unit codes, dimensions and cryptographic digests. It
# contains no corpus bytes, no third-party artwork, and nothing derived from
# the reference implementation mounted at references/ag-psd. IMPLEMENTER-
# LEGAL: consuming this file is not reading references/.
# One row per sampled-tip record, in file order. `sha256` is the SHA-256
# of the DECODED coverage mask (row-major, one byte per pixel, exactly
# w*h bytes, NOT inverted). `png_oracle` names the independently
# published transparent PNG whose ALPHA CHANNEL hashes to the same
# value — the artefact that settles polarity (spec §2.5).
# A digest is a one-way function of the artwork: it pins the decode
# exactly while carrying none of the picture. That is what makes this
# file publishable where the corpus itself is gitignored.
# Regenerate: ANALYST role only, with references/abr-fixtures/ mounted.
